INTER-OFFICE CORRESPONDENCE
120 PARK AVENUE, NEW YORK, NY 10017-5592

To: Distribution

Date: July 15, 1993

2023013100

From: Denise F. Keane

Subject: Inventory of Documents Regarding Environmental Tobacco Smoke

Philip Morris has been sued in litigation where personal injuries allegedly have been sustained as a result of exposure to environmental tobacco smoke (ETS). In order to obtain necessary information to defend this litigation and render legal advice, outside counsel have requested assistance in document identification.
To this end, please examine all files under your control, whether personal, central, active or inactive, for any materials on ETS, and please provide the input requested on the attached document inventory form. In addition, please provide some statement as to whether you have computerized records that would fall within the subject matters of this request. As noted above, attached for your convenience is a form on which to record this information.
Please forward this memorandum and attachments to all personnel under your supervision who have at any time worked on projects related to ETS and ask them to likewise examine their files and complete the inventory form. (Where possible, we have attached a list of suggested recipients; please add or delete names as necessary.)
It is difficult to identify in advance documents which may be responsive to litigation document requests that have not yet been made. As a general matter, however, categories of documents listed in Appendix A of the PM Records Management Manual may be relevant, and should guide you in completing the inventory. For your convenience, I have attached a copy of Appendix A.

Please complete the enclosed inventory form and return it to Clare Purcell (R&D/E Building - Richmond) by August 16.

Attachments
